venue.fullName: Campo de Fútbol Municipal Santa Ana

keyEvents.text: Goal! Utebo 0, Sabadell 1. Nikolay Obolskiy (Sabadell) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal.
Goal! Utebo 0, Sabadell 2. Alain Ribeiro (Sabadell) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Yanis Rahmani.
Goal! Utebo 0, Sabadell 3. Yanis Rahmani (Sabadell) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Nikolay Obolskiy.
Joel Castillo (Utebo) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Penalty saved. Gastón Valles (Sabadell) right footed shot saved in the centre of the goal.
Adrián Pereda Franco (Utebo) Penalty - Saved at 60'
Quim Utgés (Sabadell) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Samuel Bauló Mejías (CD Sabadell) Substitution at 74'
Fran Rivera Clavero (CD Sabadell) Substitution at 74'
Roger Farrerons Vila (CD Sabadell) Substitution at 85'
Diego Royo (Utebo) is shown the red card for violent conduct.
